requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 每 2 秒向串口监视器输出一次 Hello Arduino。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Provide io_0 deltas of 5ms repeatedly for at least 4000ms total elapsed model time (i.e., 5ms for 800 steps).
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_1 is true (prints 'Hello Arduino') exactly at the first control step where the accumulated time reaches >=2000ms, and again when the accumulated time reaches >=4000ms; io_1 is false on all other steps.
